text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: AZ12-high-cpu-eviction-rate (severity: P1). Auto-suppression engaged (reason: repeated flapping). PagerDuty incident id PD-95231

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: incident PD-95231 auto-suppressed by suppression policy 'repeated-flap-v2'. No page delivered. Use /pager override to force page.

ton y-oncall: ack. I see suppressed PD. I'm @tony-oncall taking initial triage. Can someone dump recent autoscaler logs from az12?

mia-sre: on it. initial read: fleet autoscaler started backoff after continuous Preflight errors from infra-probe for the last 6m. eviction metrics jumping 12%->36% across model-serving pods.

luis-eng: looks like the new kernel patch rolled yesterday caused a node kubelet OOM on two hosts in az12, kube-probes failing, autoscaler tightening.

ton y-oncall: ok. this is causing reduced capacity and sudden evictions. customer-facing tokens show increased 5xx and token latency. nora, can support confirm customer complaints?

nora-support: support queue: 18 incidents referencing degraded generation latencies in eu region over last 10m, 7 escalated. Major customers "NovusPay" and "LexiDocs" flagged for higher error rates. ETA on mitigation?

mia-sre: propose: (1) temporary gradual divert of new traffic away from az12 to az11 (traffic-weight change), (2) manual scale-up of spare pooled nodes in az12 to reduce eviction, (3) lift PD suppression to alert pagers if situation worsens.

sarah-dev: +1 on gradual divert. we can update routing weights in service-router; will push a 20% weight shift now then observe.

luis-eng: manual scale: running command to spin 4 reserved nodes in az12 now:
```bash
./infractl allocate-nodes --region eu --az az12 --count 4 --type pooled --reason "incident PD-95231 manual scale"
```
leaving logs in infra job #7832.

mia-sre: I'm toggling autopager suppression override to false so PD will deliver pages if errors spike again. Doing: /pager override --incident PD-95231 --force-unmute.

pagerduty-bot: PD override applied by mia-sre. Notifications now enabled for PD-95231.

ton y-oncall: Sarah, after weight shift, please run a quick smoke against a few heavy customers to validate reroute behavior (curl + header X-Test-Customer).

sarah-dev: running checks now. sample command:
```bash
for id in NovusPay LexiDocs; do curl -s -H "X-Customer: $id" https://api.redwood-inference.example/health/generate | jq '.latency'; done
```
first pass: latencies on az11 -> 220ms, az12 -> 1.2s (errors intermittently 502).

nora-support: notifying affected customers via status update draft: "We are aware of increased generation errors in EU and are diverting traffic; reduced impact expected within 15–30 minutes." Approving now.

ton y-oncall: timeline: (T+0) suppression override and manual scale triggered. (T+2m) traffic weight shift +20% to az11. (T+8m) observe metrics. If evictions persist or 5xx > 5%, escalate to PD oncall-2.

mia-sre: metrics snapshot (just pulled):
```
az12: eviction_rate=34%, pod_5xx_pct=7.8%, cpu_util=87%
az11: eviction_rate=2.1%, pod_5xx_pct=0.6%, cpu_util=62%
```

luis-eng: infra jobs show two problematic hosts marked NotReady due to oom-kill on kubelet cgroups. I'm reimaging one (host eu-az12-gnode-07) and removing taint from a warm spare.

mia-sre: after weight change + node allocation: az12 pod_5xx_pct down to 3.2%, eviction_rate 15% — improving but still unstable. we should keep gradual divert in place and continue manual adds.

tony-oncall: good. since suppression is lifted, if PD fires we'll escalate. Who's owning the handoff in 30m?

sarah-dev: I can take second 30m watch, then hand to engineering rotations. we'll collect logs and add to incident doc.

nora-support: status page live: https://status.redwood-inference.example/incidents/PD-95231 (message posted). customers notified.

luis-eng: creating temporary routing flag to enforce 40% spillover if threshold crosses. command:
```json
{"action":"set-weight","service":"text-gen","from":"az12","to":"az11","weight":40}
```
apply in 5m if evictions don't drop below 10%.

mia-sre: note for post-incident: suppression policy allowed a repeating suppression during an active degradation which hid pager deliveries. We should adjust suppression window for zone-flaps. Filing follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident PD-95231 acknowledged by tony-oncall. Current severity: P1 -> degraded. Updates will be appended to this thread.

ton y-oncall: summary: manual nodes allocated, traffic shifted, PD suppression lifted, customers notified. Next steps: continue watch, reimage remaining bad host, prepare fallback plan to fully divert if 5xx > 5% for 10m.

mia-sre: currently monitoring Grafana dashboards and will post if we hit the 40% spill threshold.

sarah-dev: handoff note posted to #incidents-handoffs. I'm now taking the active follow for next 30m. :thumbsup:

nora-support: I'll keep the support queue updated and pull any legal/enterprise escalations if they appear.

[end of thread]
